morphology.pattern_note: 作为外来专名整体记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。资料包未提供可核实的马来语标准读音、分音节或爪夷文。专名通常写作 Optimus；本条以 Optimus Prime 为例，原始词形本身不足以确定所指。

senses.zh_definition: 外来专名形式；例如 Optimus Prime，指《变形金刚》中的擎天柱。具体所指须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A foreign proper name; for example, Optimus Prime, an Autobot leader in Transformers. Its referent depends on context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas asing; misalnya Optimus Prime, pemimpin Autobot dalam Transformers. Rujukannya bergantung pada konteks.
senses.nuances: 未核实为马来语普通词，不能标注为已获 DBP 认可的普通词条。以下搭配和例句仅示范角色名用法，不代表已证实的高频搭配。不能将其直接解释为 optimis（乐观的／乐观者）或 optimum（最适宜的）。角色身份参见 [Hasbro 官方说明](https://instructions.hasbro.com/en-us/instruction/transformers-cybertron-leader-class-optimus-prime-figure)。

etymology.historical_story: Latin optimus means “best” and functions as the superlative of bonus, “good.” That Latin meaning should be distinguished from a modern name. Hasbro identifies Optimus Prime as an Autobot leader, but the isolated packet does not establish that this character is its intended referent or that optimus is an established Malay common word. [Lewis and Short](https://alatius.com/ls/index.php?l=optuma), [Hasbro](https://instructions.hasbro.com/en-us/instruction/transformers-cybertron-leader-class-optimus-prime-figure).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Optimus Prime，就联想擎天柱；单独看到 optimus，先确认它是哪一个专名。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 专名本身不涉及敬语等级；正式介绍角色时，首次使用全名 Optimus Prime。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合影视、玩具及相关品牌语境。一般公文若表达“乐观”或“最佳水平”，应分别选用 optimis 或 optimum 等符合原意的词。
